post.summary: The only score/penalty mutation. reason DECISION, APPEAL_REFUND or DECISION_VOID; a decision causes at most one change of each reason. Session must not score DecisionRecorded again. New changes require ACTIVE state and the stored MODERATOR. Retries are recognized after completion. Adjustment reasons change score/penalties only; recorded correctness is historical and is not inferred from a refund/void. Post-completion result changes are forbidden.
post.x-idempotency: scoreChangeId: the same id with identical content applies at most once and returns applied=false with the current score; the same id with different content is 409 SCORE_CHANGE_CONFLICT
